result:
Done.

**Root cause:** in `variants/bug05/movegen.inc`, `clrCastleSq` masked the a1 corner with `and 0xFE` (bit 0 = white *kingside*) instead of `and 0xFD` (bit 1 = white *queenside*), so a1 traffic revoked the wrong right — and the surviving queenside right made `genCastling` emit an O-O-O with no rook on a1, whose make/unmake pair in the legal-move filter fabricated a rook back onto a1 during the opponent's move.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug05/movegen.inc` — the mask fix (`and 0xFE` → `and 0xFD`) plus two clarifying comments; exactly one byte changes in `chess.bin` (offset 4426)
- `variants/bug05/test_castling_rights.py` — new, 16-case regression test
- `variants/bug05/Makefile` — runs that test as the last step of `make test`
- `variants/bug05/BUILD.md` — documents the new step and script
- `variants/bug05/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — at workspace root

**Gate status**
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — PASS (all 3 repros and both controls match the report's "Expected")
- `make test` — PASS, 6/6 steps, including the perft self-test that printed `PERFT BAD` before (Kiwipete d3 now 97862)
- New test — PASS: 16 ok / 0 failed on the fixed build; 9 ok / 7 failed on the pre-fix tape, with the reds confined to the a1 family, so it discriminates
- `characterisation/characterise.py` — PASS: 57 ok / 0 failed / exit 0 (54 ok / 3 failed before). Since `expected.json` was recorded from the pristine tape, this says the fix restores pristine behaviour exactly. Note it needs `--harness harness`; its default path points outside this workspace
- Review round — CLEAN: one round, verdict "No defects in the fix", gate closed at 1 of 3

**Knowingly left open**
`genCastling` trusts the rights byte and does not re-check that a rook stands on the corner, so a self-inconsistent *loaded* position can still fabricate rooks. It is pre-existing, symmetric across all four corners, present identically on the pre-fix tape, unreachable from legal play once the mask is right, and pinned as pristine behaviour by the characterisation suite — recorded as finding B1 in `FIX_NOTES.md` §6 rather than fixed. Also recorded there and not fixed: a temp-dir leak in `harness/tools/play.py`, the ~10 s the new step adds to `make test`, and an incomplete `SRC` dependency list in the variant Makefile. Three cheap non-blocking findings (two extra test cases, the BUILD.md update) were applied and re-verified after the review; the assembly fix itself is unchanged since it was reviewed.
